nodes.label: Spec 4: Editor
Agent edits with agentEdit mark (D-10)
nodes.rationale: Agent text keeps an agentEdit mark until a human accepts it; accepting removes the mark, is undoable and synced. Quiet highlight per D-15: thin green bar on left margin, text itself not colored.

nodes.label: Block editor with Markdown shortcuts
nodes.rationale: Storage is own block tree in CRDT; Markdown is only export and agent format (D-01).

nodes.label: Created-by-agent banner (NoteMeta.createdByAgent, D-45)
nodes.rationale: A note fully created by an agent is not highlighted line by line; instead a calm banner 'Created by agent {name}' with 'Got it'.

nodes.label: Edge autoscroll and selection stability (iOS build 37)
nodes.rationale: Owner feedback: selection 'impossible to work with'; target Apple Notes behavior. Quadratic speed 80-700 pt/s, band 56 pt capped to 1/5 of visible text.

nodes.label: Literal [[Title]] text rendered as link
nodes.rationale: Agents write [[Title]] for non-existent notes; editor shows it as a link and the app opens or offers to create the note.

nodes.label: Local full-text search index per client
nodes.rationale: Server cannot search encrypted content, so the index lives on each client.

nodes.label: Mermaid on iOS in offline WKWebView (security audit)
nodes.rationale: Same mermaid 12.2.0 as web; offscreen WKWebView with all network blocked, no storage, securityLevel strict.

nodes.label: New note title like Apple Notes (focusTitle / defaultTitle)
nodes.rationale: User decision 2026-10-26: cursor in title on create, Enter moves to body, empty title auto-filled with 'Note <date>'; fully empty note not saved, like Apple Notes.

nodes.label: One-title rule and start-of-document repair
nodes.rationale: Clients write title block+; damaged starts repaired idempotently and deterministically in one Yjs transaction outside undo; rule 1 (empty duplicate titles) runs before rule 3 (restore demoted title).

nodes.label: Lined/grid/dot paper aligned to text baseline
nodes.rationale: Line step equals body line height so text sits on lines like GoodNotes; inline elements must not grow line height.

nodes.label: Platform implementation: iOS UIKit+TextKit 2, web TipTap+Yjs
nodes.rationale: Both editors work over the same CRDT document structure, so its schema is a shared contract verified by test vectors.

nodes.label: App-side remote image downloader (https only, no private addresses)
nodes.rationale: iOS editor never downloads itself; only app loader fetches URLs with size/time limits and no private addresses.

nodes.label: Rich paste mapping (HTML/RTF/Markdown to blocks)
nodes.rationale: One mapping on all clients matching agent Markdown import, checked by shared test vectors.

nodes.label: Unknown/invalid nodes are never deleted
nodes.rationale: Nodes, attributes and marks not known or failing schema are shown as-is or as 'Unsupported block' and saved; opening writes nothing (document-model.md).

nodes.label: Voice phase 1 on web: dictation and 'Format...'
nodes.rationale: Web Speech API not used because Chrome sends audio to Google; audio goes to own server /voice/transcribe then /voice/text clean.

nodes.label: Web protection from harmful content (colors, links, paste)
nodes.rationale: Security audit 2026-10-27, in addition to app CSP: only safe colors/alignments/links; pasted content parsed in inert document.

nodes.label: Single Y.UndoManager over content and strokes
nodes.rationale: Strokes undo together with text; each stroke is its own step.

nodes.label: Export: Markdown, PDF, HTML (handwriting as images)
